When Online Mandi Prices Mislead: Zero-Tuned-Parameter Dispatch Filtering

The Operational Illusion (Zero-Lookahead 171 Mkts)

Portals such as AGMARKNET display neighbouring wholesale spreads above ₹100/qtl. Chasing raw lagged spreads across 57,634 test episodes (B1_lagged_screen) loses money on 45.07% of dispatches (ES10 −₹642.15/qtl).

Role (A17 #10): MandiGuard sits at 6 a.m. upstream portal-alert triage ahead of a 30-second confirmation call to a destination arhtiya — cutting noise, not replacing trader verification.

Slide 3 of 12 • Timing Firewall (R3)

Strict <= t - 1 Information Firewall & Weather Leak Removal

What Was Audited and Removed (N1, C1)

  • Removed Day-t Price/Shortlist Leak (C1): Legacy shortlists leaked same-day prices. Replaced end-to-end from raw parquets (dest_quote_date < t, origin_quote_date < t across 317,985 shortlisted rows).
  • Removed 98.64% ERA5 Weather Leak (N1): Auditing 67,135 rows showed fc_rain_mm == era5_rain_mm on 66,222 rows (99.93% RH within 1%).
  • Weather-Free Decisions + Realized ERA5 Check: Primary 20°C reference requires zero weather telemetry; 100.0% arrival ERA5 runs strictly inside settlement.

Counterfactual Corruption Proof (pytest)

tests/test_timing_and_leakage_r3.py mutates all portal records on days ≥ t*:

  • Inserts ₹99,999/qtl spikes at excluded yards on day t*;
  • Halves origin day-t* modal prices;
  • Deletes active candidate yards on day t*.

Result: Bit-for-bit equality verified on candidate menu & every decision feature for t ≤ t*.

Slide 4 of 12 • Physical Settlement & Costs

Destination-Base APMC Fees (M9) & Sequential Settlement (A4)

Physical Cost & Decay Model

Froad = 35.0 + 0.45 × hs × road_km   (hs = 1.45 in HP, 1.0 elsewhere)
s(k, w) = min(0.55, bk × max(1, hours + 24w) / 24)   [0.86%–3.25% / 24h]

Stylized fee tier 0.5%–1.5% applies strictly to post-decay destination sale revenue (0% intra-district or on unsold return).

Day-by-Day Non-Anticipative Settlement (tau = 1..3d): Sell if exact variety prints on arrival day w; wait 1d (₹25/qtl detention) only if another variety trades; else turn back (-div*F - loc*sp).

  • Hard-Gated MG_T1_T2_matched (4 params, ML-stripped): Failed ES10 (−₹508.72, p_2s = 0.241–0.343 NS); strict split-conformal T1..T4 (q80=162.5) reaches cond_ES10 −₹525.17 (v7_exp4).
  • Tuned RR_Abstain_matched (A10, 1.6/5): Hit grid edge kappa* = 5.0 (at kappa=20, m_val = −₹328.99); ignored cv28 & Sunday closures.

Lower-Bound Heuristic Simplification & ML/OR Pareto

  • 7 fixed choices (0 validation-tuned params; NO methodological novelty claimed).
  • Safe_EV_Sunk_m0 (cond_ES10 −₹447.48, 63.23%) beats comparable-coverage <= t-1 Ridge (−₹530.30), HGBR_EV_TV (−₹523.53), Vargas Mean-Var (−₹496.76), & HGBR_RiskAverse_L500 (−₹512.43); Q20 reaches −₹444.86 at half disp (32.83%, Mean ₹266.43).

  • Added clean 166-mkt 2018–2023 (383,952) + NASA POWER & <= t-2 latency audit (v7_exp1).

Slide 6 of 12 • Two Zero-Tuned-Parameter Rules

Two Tuning-Free Pocket-Calculator Equations (PREREG_A18.md)

1. Safe_EV_Sunk_m0 (Scientific & ES10 Champion, 0 Params)

G1SD = Pdest(1 − cv28)(1 − τfee) − Porig
pdow · G1SD − Froad > 0  ⇔  G1SD / Froad > 1 / pdow

Worked MP Tomato Route (200km, F=₹125, G=₹470, cv28=0.15 → G_1SD=₹174.50):

  • Steady Yard A (p_dow = 0.90): 0.90 × 174.50 − 125 = +₹32.05 → DISPATCH
  • Sunday-Closed Yard B (p_dow = 0.20): 0.20 × 174.50 − 125 = −₹90.10 → ABSTAIN

2. RT_2F_Min_m0 (Class-8 4-Function Calculator, 0 Params)

G = Pdest(1 − τfee) − Porig,    pmin = min(rep28, pdow)
pmin · G − 2 Froad > 0  ⇔  G / (2 Froad) > 1 / pmin

No cv28 volatility and no NABCONS decay needed!

  • Steady Yard A (p_min = 0.85): 0.85 × 470 − 250 = +₹149.50 → DISPATCH
  • Sunday Yard B (p_min = 0.20): 0.20 × 470 − 250 = −₹156.00 → ABSTAIN (B2 chased +₹345!)
